title: Haye Lut Gaya Fatima ka Ghar
body:
Haye lut gaya Fatima ka ghar
Umme laila ka jawaa saal pisar, tukde barchi se huva jis ka jigar, maa ko kistarha sunaye yeh khabar, marna jaye kahin wo rorokar
Run mein pamaal huva ibne hasan, khaaq par baithi hai lamhao ki dulhan, haye kangney ki jagah ab hai rasan, aur nahi usko mayasar chadar
Teeray seh shobha wo asgar ka gala, haal aada se bhi dekha na gaya, phair kar rote the sab mu apna, shai ne kis dil se dekha manzar
<<DIVIDER>>
Chaar su bikhrey hain run mein laashay, kaheen jarrar ke bazu hai paday, kaun aakar unhe ab dafn kare, kaisi gurbath hai sabhi lashao par
Run mein paiham thi ye Sarwar ki fugaa, ab na Qasim hai na Akbar sa jawaa, ho chuke qatl sabhi qurdokala, dasht mein aaj hai huu ka manzar
Gunjti thi yahi zehra ki sada, kundh khanjar mere bachchay ka gala, kya isi din ke liye tha pala, meri aagoosh mein aaja dilbar
Haye wo Shaam-e-garibaan ka sama, the sabhi khaimey jaha shola fishaa, hai pareshaan haram jaye kahaa, gash hai sajjad to Zainab muztar
<<DIVIDER>>
Thi Sakina ki fugaa mere chacha, dekhiye jal gaya mera kurta, aye sohail hogi gash wo dukhiya, shumr ne cheen liye jab gouhar..
